entities.name: Local time zone
entities.description: Information element sent by the network indicating the time zone applicable to the current tracking area and tracking area list.

entities.name: Network daylight saving time
entities.description: Information element indicating when the local time zone has been adjusted for daylight saving time.

entities.name: Daylight saving time adjustment
entities.description: Condition where the local time zone has been adjusted for daylight saving time.

entities.name: Time zone applicability
entities.description: Property that the local time zone applies to the tracking area of the current cell and the tracking area list if available.

entities.name: Time information inaccuracy
entities.description: Property that time information can be inaccurate when TAI list includes tracking areas from different time zones.

relations.description: Local time zone IE establishes that the time zone applies to current tracking area and tracking area list.
Local time zone IE establishes potential inaccuracy when TAI list includes tracking areas from different time zones.
Daylight saving time adjustment condition requires inclusion of Network daylight saving time IE.
